_description: qutebrowser declarative settings, projected into home-manager's programs.qutebrowser.settings attrset.

url._note: Homepage + every new tab open the generated bookmark dashboard (da_my-browser/src/dashboard). Installed at ~/.config/qutebrowser/qute-bookmarks.html by the home-module.

window._note: Brand the window/taskbar title 'my-browser' (display brand; project dir is da_my-browser, GHCR image keeps the qutebrowser-standalone identity).

_plugins_note: content.blocking.enabled, content.javascript.enabled and content.autoplay are OWNED by the plugin registry (qute-plugins.json — ids adblock/javascript/no-autoplay) so they are runtime-toggleable via :plugins; they are intentionally NOT set here to avoid a double source of truth. Non-toggle sub-keys (blocking.method/lists, javascript.clipboard) stay here.

auto_save._note: Restore the last session (open tabs) on startup instead of a fresh dashboard window. Saves the _autosave session on quit; restored on next launch when no URL is given on the CLI (start_pages still used for brand-new/-empty sessions).

colors._description: Dark theme tuned to the rest of the stack (KDE Plasma Breeze Dark). Keys map 1:1 to qutebrowser's colors.* settings; the projection flattens them to c.colors.<path>.
